summary: The substantive P17 obligations are genuinely implemented and independently reproduced: a fresh 4.33.0-rc2 build of the ten new Lean modules (995/995, 0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 native_decide, axiom audits 175/175 and 73/73 theorems, forbidden=0), a 17/17 vault source campaign with 19-cell model-versus-EVM comparison and complete emitter-bound logs, a 12/12 token0 campaign preserving the accepted P16 r6 fail-closed grammar, 2 vault and 6 token0 genuinely compiled production mutants with intact controls, and both adapters instantiating the unchanged Typed.execute_ok_iff with proved e.Valid premises. This is not a scalar-only, wrapper-only or arithmetic-only delivery. Five concrete defects remain, one of which (R-2) is the accepted contract's own gate condition for P17.platform_reuse.

binds: scenario: Ordinary token0 add is a nonzero quote-register effect
required_repairs.title: The token0 quote-register wrap is not built via Quantity.toQuantity from the library result, and the pre-register binding is never stated
required_repairs.trigger: grep -n 'preQ\|postQ\|lift' lean/DefiKernel/ConcentratedLiquidity/Token0Bridge.lean : `lift` and `lift_scale_one` are defined and never used; preQ and postQ are bare rational literals; no theorem relates them to sqrtP_Q96 or postWord.
required_repairs.soundness: Not unsound. Reviewer diagnostic C2 proves preQ = (lift sqrtP_Q96).amount and postQ = (lift postWord).amount, each in one line, exit 0.
required_repairs.repair: Define preQ := (lift sqrtP_Q96).amount and postQ := (lift postWord).amount (or state the two equalities as theorems and rewrite with them in evaluated_Valid / ordinary_effect_nonzero), so the template quantities are the scale-1 lift of the actual library input and the actual library Word 160 result.
required_repairs.why_it_matters: The obligation names Quantity.toQuantity as the lift and requires the pre-register to equal the input sqrtPX96. A helper that exists but is never called earns no credit, and this is the token0 half of the two-case reuse witness.

binds: mutation sensitivity cannot pass empty or omit unavailable members

required_repairs.trigger: `detected = (des_status == 'ok' and des_ret_uint == des_planned['value'])` -- detection is defined as the mutant reproducing its own pre-registered mutated prediction. Nothing asserts planned_designated differs from P16_FIXTURES[designated]['expected'].
required_repairs.status_today: All six planned mutated outputs do in fact differ from their intact expectations (reviewer-verified table in REVIEW.md), so this run's 6/6 detection is substantively real.
required_repairs.repair: Assert planned_designated != the intact fixture expectation (blocked otherwise), and/or define detection as the scored comparison against the intact expectation failing, matching vault_mutants.py's `gate == 'fail'`.
required_repairs.why_it_matters: As written the check cannot fail for a non-detecting mutant, which is exactly the empty-check pattern the gate register forbids.

scope_limitations: This review covers the frozen P17 candidate only. It is not a whole-DeFiFormal completion review and claims none.
No mainnet, deployed-address, block, bytecode-identity or codehash claim is made or accepted. Usds/Vat/Join mocks remain harness assumptions.
Accrual with timestamp > rho, _rpow, vat.suck, usdsJoin.exit, permit/IERC1271, UUPS upgrade and the L2 token remain out of scope and unverified.
The quote register is a model-only synthetic register: not Uniswap pool storage, not cash settlement, not a source observation.
P21 widening and P30 source refinement remain closed. No composition or sequential token0-to-vault workflow is claimed.
D0/D1 is a stable-time domain (timestamp == rho); D1 chi is a storage seed that is explicitly not protocol-reachable.
Bounded EVM execution and Lean #eval runtime rows are finite witnesses, not proofs; the Lean theorems are the mathematical authority.

Reviewer diagnostics (work/checks/*, lean/review_opus_diag/) are review-authored artifacts, separately identified, with intact controls. They are not candidate source and grant the candidate no credit.
The reviewer did not read or write the author worktree at any point.
